brief:
Gaza's petroleum authority announced Monday that five trucks carrying cooking gas had entered the territory, according to Shehab Wire. The shipment marks a delivery of fuel supplies to the densely populated enclave, where shortages of essential commodities have persisted amid the ongoing conflict.

The authority provided no immediate details on the distribution timeline, quantities per vehicle, or intended recipients of the cooking gas shipment. The announcement comes as Gaza faces continued constraints on the movement of goods across its borders.
